fact: The National Registration Act [Chapter 10:17], an Act of Parliament commenced 24 September 1976, sets up the Registrar-General of National Registration, a register of residents and identity documents, and the consolidated text is stated as up to date as at 31 December 2016.

Statutory Instrument 10 of 2024, gazetted 30 January 2024, was made by the Minister of Home Affairs and Cultural Heritage under section 11 of the National Registration Act [Chapter 10:17], showing the Act in force.

The National Registration Act [Chapter 10:17], an Act of Parliament commenced 24 September 1976, provides for registration of residents, a register kept by the Registrar-General and identity documents, in a ZimLII consolidation up to date as at 31 December 2016.
